name: react-native-ambire-crypto
description: Rust-accelerated keccak256 and ABI decode for Ambire (POC)

scripts.ubrn:android: ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --release --and-generate && yarn ubrn:postgenerate
scripts.ubrn:ios: ubrn build ios --config ubrn.config.yaml --release --and-generate && yarn ubrn:postgenerate
scripts.ubrn:clean: rm -rfv cpp/ android/CMakeLists.txt android/src/main/java android/*.cpp ios/ src/Native* src/index.*ts* src/generated/
